note: Adapted from entry 88 of Roonwal & Chhotani (1997), originally in English. The original describes only the soldier and records the alate as unknown; the diagnostic characters follow the soldier key of that work (p. 572). The synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers, type-specimen records and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule rectangular, length to mandibular base 1.94–2.19 mm, mandible length/head length ratio about 0.65, mandibular teeth distinct, head darker and wider (width/head length ratio 0.64–0.65), pronotum with a convex anterior margin, a deep median concavity and rather broad anterolateral corners. Separated from parabengalensis in the key as follows: the latter has shorter mandibles (mandible length/head length ratio 0.55–0.59), indistinct mandibular teeth, and a paler and narrower head (width/head length ratio 0.60–0.62). Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown, posterior part yellowish brown; postclypeus and antennal ridges slightly darker than the head; anteclypeus white; labrum pale brown; mandibles dark reddish brown at the base and nearly black at the apex; antennal base dark reddish brown, apex pale reddish brown; pronotum brown; legs and abdomen brownish yellow. Head and abdomen moderately hairy: the labrum bears 2 setae in the middle and several more on the anterior and anterolateral margins; the postmentum bears scattered setae; the pronotal margins bear a few hairs and setae. Head capsule rectangular, distinctly longer than wide (length to mandibular base 1.94–2.19, width 1.26–1.39 mm), the sides nearly parallel and slightly convergent anteriorly, the posterior corners rounded, the posterior margin slightly convex. Fontanelle small, circular, situated slightly anterior to the middle of the head. Eyes small, oval, indistinct; ocelli absent. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 the smallest, segment 3 strongly sclerotized and twice as long as segment 2. Postclypeus indistinctly delimited from the frontal area, with a few hairs. Anteclypeus bare, semi-transparent. Mandibles stout, sabre-shaped, length 1.26–1.39 mm; the left mandible with an indistinct tooth-like projection slightly below the middle and a larger knob-like process near the base; the right mandible with a small tooth on the basal 1/3. Labrum dome-shaped, wider than long (width 0.36–0.42, length 0.29–0.33 mm). Postmentum length 1.44–1.71 mm, club-shaped, widest in the anterior 1/3 and bilobed there (maximum width 0.52–0.61 mm), then narrowing into a long waist (waist width 0.20–0.21 mm) and widening again slightly towards the posterior margin. Pronotum flat, wider than long, slightly narrower than the head (length 0.62–0.73, width 1.14–1.32 mm); anterior margin convex with a deep median concavity, the sides convex, the posterior margin nearly straight. Tibial spurs 3:2:2, tarsi 3-segmented.
